info.title: DEEM Portal API
info.description: DEEM Portal API - Customers, Addresses, Services, Invoices, Vouchers, Joining, HR modules (Auth, Attendance, Report, Leave, Task, Profile, Manager, Meet, Today Leave, Birthday, Joining, Policy), Designations, Announcements and Notifications

get.summary: Get all addresses of a customer
Get all services of a customer

designationId.description: Designation ID from the designation table

400.description: Designation is required, designation not found, or candidate is already an employee

500.description: Failed to save candidate as employee

get.summary: Get all joining applicants (new joining module)
get.description: Same path as the legacy POST /api/join-candidate but a different method, so both coexist. Queries the Join_candidate table ordered by id DESC.

200.description: Login successful, returns JWT token and user object
Reset code sent (response also contains debug_token)

400.description: Token and new password required, or invalid code

post.summary: Attendance punch in / punch out (file upload optional)
post.description: multipart/form-data. First punch of the day for an eid+date creates an IN record (intime required); a second call with outtime marks OUT. Optional single file field named file (jpg/jpeg/png, max 5 MB) uploads to Cloudinary folder deem_selfies.

200.description: In Time Marked or Out Time Marked

400.description: eid and date required / In time missing / Out time missing / Already OUT punched today / multer upload error

get.summary: Get attendance records for an employee

200.description: Attendance records returned as a JSON array (raw rows, not wrapped)

delete.summary: Delete all reports for an email

200.description: Returns count of deleted reports, e.g. N reports deleted

400.description: All fields required / An entry for this date already exists

get.summary: Get leave balance by eid or email
get.description: Code registers two Express routes with the same pattern: GET /leave/leave-balance/:eid and GET /leave/leave-balance/:email. The first match wins; the controller also accepts an email-looking :eid value and an optional ?email query. Pass the employee id or the email address as {identifier}.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Fallback email lookup used by the controller

200.description: Returns { success, eid, ename, lbal, leaveBalance }

get.summary: Get leave applications for an employee

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Optional status filter: 0 PENDING, 1 HR PENDING, 2 APPROVED, 3 REJECTED, 4 WITHDRAWEL

200.description: Returns { success, data } with status_name per row
Returns { success, data } with status_name per task (0 Todo, 1 Doing, 2 Done)
